descriptionChirho: A formal religious assembly or sacred convocation, typically associated with festival closings or days of fasting and worship. All four clusters represent grammatical forms (bare/construct singular, construct singular, with 2mp suffix, with conjunction waw) of the same cultic term. Multilingual glosses confirm one unified meaning: eng: assembly/solemn assembly/your assemblies/solemn gathering, spa: asamblea/asamblea solemne/sus asambleas solemnes/reunion solemne, hin: सभा/समापन सभा/सभाओं/पवित्र सभा (assembly/closing assembly/assemblies/holy assembly), arb: اعتكاف/احتفال/عصيرة/محافلكم (retreat/celebration/assembly/your gatherings), kor: 성회/엄숙한 모임/성회들/집회 (sacred assembly/solemn meeting/assemblies), swa: kusanyiko takatifu/mkutano mtakatifu/makusanyiko matakatifu (holy gathering/holy meeting/holy gatherings).
